newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Treasury uses Eni greenshoe option.
newsitem.headline: Italy Treasury uses Eni greenshoe option.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Wednesday it was exercising its 'greenshoe' overallotment option to sell a further 143 million ordinary shares in state- controlled energy group ENI.
The Treasury said in a statement exercising the 'greenshoe' option took to 17.6 percent the total size of Eni's capital offered in the sale of the third tranche.
The Treasury made a third tranche offering of shares in the energy giant in June in the biggest placement in its history.

The Treasury said the number of shares sold in the third tranche of privatisation totalled 1.408 billion, including those in the overallotment option. The Treasury's total gross income for the entire third placement was equal to 13.3 trillion lire.
"The Treasury's stake in the company thus falls today to 51.5 percent," the ministry added.

It said the greenshoe option, which had been exercised in full, had been carried out by Italian investment bank IMI and Credit Suisse First Boston, global coordinators for the third tranche placement.
